extDescription:

Your opponent cannot Synchro Summon. You can destroy 1 Equip Card equipped to a monster your opponent controls and inflict 400 damage to your opponent.

name: Blackwing - Gram the Shining Star
extDescription:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Must first be Synchro Summoned. When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower non-Tuner "Blackwing" monster from your hand. Its effects are negated.

extDescription:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn, during either player's turn (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 face-up card you control; once during this turn, it cannot be destroyed by battle or by card effects.

extDescription: If you have no cards in your hand: You can banish this card from your Graveyard to target 2 Level 3 or lower "Infernity" monsters in your Graveyard; Special Summon them from the Graveyard, but their effects are negated.

name: Catapult Warrior
extDescription:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 "Junk" monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to the original ATK of the Tributed monster.

name: Hot Red Dragon Archfiend
extDescription:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can destoy all other face-up Attack Position monsters on the field. Monsters other than this card cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

name: Black Rose Moonlight Dragon
extDescription:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Special Summoned, or a Level 5 or higher monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field: Target 1 Special Summoned monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand. You can only use this effect of "Black Rose Moonlight Dragon" once per turn.

name: Beelzeus of the Diabolic Dragons
extDescription:
1 DARK Tuner + 2 or more non-Tuner monsters
Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. Other monsters you control cannot attack. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; any battle damage your opponent takes from attacks involving this card this turn is halved, also, change that monster's ATK to 0, and if you do, gain LP equal to its original ATK.

name: Stardust Chronicle Spark Dragon
extDescription:
1 Tuner Synchro Monster + 1 or more non-Tuner Synchro Monsters
Must be Synchro Summoned, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can banish 1 Synchro Monster from your Graveyard; this card is unaffected by other cards' effects for the rest of this turn. If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card (by battle or card effect): You can target 1 of your banished Dragon-Type Synchro Monsters; Special Summon it.
